items.title: US thanksgiving storm floods coastal towns, knocks out power for over 900,000
items.summary: This Thanksgiving weekend, a fierce storm has significantly disrupted both travel and holiday festivities in numerous states. Power outages affected over 900,000 people, primarily in Pennsylvania and Virginia. Emergency teams were mobilized to assist residents stranded by rising floodwaters in coastal areas. The Midwest dealt with heavy snow that halted transportation and caused some structural collapses.
